answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 45216 Country: India Title: Not able to succeed in Business or Job, kindly guide me how to overcome this issue. Horrible blocked not able to fulfill small needs. Question: I am not able to survive in job or business, from both sides I am losing from past 1.5 years. I started import export business I lost huge money. I am facing lots of difficulties in business and job. After losing a job I started Real Estate in this I am facing lots of difficulties, after closing the deal then it is getting bounces, this is repeating from a long time and utensils suppliers this is also happening the same, till now I have a back up of website business as well, where ever I go I am not able to earn from couple of months, I am quite confused not able to understand what is happening, in closing the deal I am losing all deals. I have applied jobs in couple of companies there feedback is still pending, at some companies they are willing to pay me very less after accepting I lost a job in one week. Another one they said they will let me know. Kindly guide me how can i improve my earnings. Answer ID: 45216 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 791/637/B=1434) You should recite durood 100 times and لا حول ولا قوة الا بالله العلى العظيم 500 times for forty days and supplicate Allah. Also recite the following dua 100-100 times in the morning and evening: اللهم اكفني بحلالك عن حرامك وأغننى بفضلك ممن سواك . In-shaAllah, you shall be relieved from all these problems. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
